scenes.revival: Garden coming back to life after one page
scenes.voice: Reading aloud, followed word by word

bareEarth.title: Bare earth.
bareEarth.text: Sixty hizb to turn it into a garden.

hizb8.title: Read, and the water flows.
hizb8.text: Every new page you read waters your garden. The channels fill up and the first trees arrive.

hizb20.title: One hizb, one new element.
hizb20.text: A tree, flowers, a fountain: each hizb you finish adds something.

hizb30.title: Halfway there, the walls rise.
hizb30.text: Your garden takes shape, hizb after hizb.

hizb40.title: The gates open.
hizb40.text: The further you go, the more beautiful it becomes.

hizb60.title: Your garden is complete.
hizb60.text: Sixty hizb: you have read the whole Quran. This garden no longer dries.

thirsty.title: Stop on the way, and it gets thirsty.
thirsty.text: The water stops flowing and the grass turns pale.

wilting.title: Then it wilts.
wilting.text: The grass yellows, the leaves fall, the channels run dry.

dying.title: The trees go bare.
dying.text: The flowers are gone and the earth cracks.

dead.title: And it turns back into dead earth.
dead.text: Two weeks without reading, and nothing is left.

revival.title: One page is enough to revive it.
revival.text: The hizb you have read stay yours. Start again, and the water returns.

voice.title: Read aloud, the app follows you.
voice.text: Each word lights up as you recite it. A misread word turns red, so you can read it again.

recognition.title: Where is this passage from?
recognition.text: Hearing a recitation? Let the app listen: it tells you the surah and the verse.

friends.title: With your loved ones.
friends.text: Visit their gardens, encourage each other, and read a khatma together.

goal.title: Your daily goal.
goal.text: It is up to you. You can change it whenever you like.

reminders.title: Your reminders.
reminders.text: So your garden never runs out of water.

thirsty.title: Your garden is thirsty
thirsty.body: One page is enough to bring the water back.
